sloka: मितं व्यक्ताक्षरपदं तमुवाचाथ दुन्दुभिम् ।हरीणामीश्वरो वाली सर्वेषां वनचारिणाम् ॥४-११-२९॥।।
transliteration: mitaṁ vyaktākṣarapadaṁ tamuvācātha dundubhim ।harīṇāmīśvaro vālī sarveṣāṁ vanacāriṇām ॥4-11-29॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali, king of the monkeys who roam the forest, saw Dundubhi and addressed, but briefly:
